# RewardsPro Shopify app

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../apps/rewards)

One embedded Shopify app where a paid order earns cashback as Shopify store credit, tiers raise the rate, a widget shows tier and credit, and refunds take the cashback back.

**Scope:** The app production serves, on Shopify's React Router template, with no billing code. Its database is schema rewards on Supabase. Its site and brand kit are apps/rewardspro.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `rewards`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. 2026-11-05: All four milestones are built. The foundation: the data model in Postgres schema rewards, with an append-only ledger and the payout checks enforced by the database, a local Postgres test bed, exact money maths, encrypted Shopify sessions. The engine: recording paid orders, cashback sent as Shopify store credit, refund take-backs, tiers and the past-orders import. The webhooks (paid orders, refunds, cancellations, compliance, uninstall, scopes); the payouts, with the hourly payout check and the nightly tier and housekeeping jobs; the admin (Home, Orders, Customers, Tiers, Settings with customer data requests); the storefront widget. The staging run on a development store is recorded in apps/rewards/docs/staging-run.md, and the final review's fixes are in. The CI job runs typecheck, unit tests, migrations, a drift check, the Postgres tests on Postgres 17 and the build. The switch record (apps/rewards/docs/switch.md) has production on this app from 2026-11-06 and version rewardspromembership-217 released on 2026-11-07; the gates after it are in apps/rewards/docs/gates.md. 2026-11-24: its own deploy and database guides were written.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Finish what the switch left: the owner's B5 steps in apps/rewards/docs/switch.md and the open erasure check in apps/rewards/docs/gates.md. Apply a migration to production before its pull request merges.
